newsitem.title: UK: IOC buys at least two Dubai, VLCCs Nigerian - trade.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys at least two Dubai, VLCCs Nigerian - trade.

text.p: The Indian Oil Corp (IOC) awarded between two and four cargoes of Dubai crude and two VLCCs of Nigerian crude in its July purchase tender, traders said on Thursday.
Two of the Dubai cargoes were likely to have been awarded to trader Phibro, which submitted bids at front month quotes +31 and +33 cents.
Other cargoes could have been awarded to Statoil and Repsol which bid at +34 and +36 cents respectively.
Details could not be immediately confirmed with the respective companies.
Traders said IOC also bought two VLCCs of Nigerian crude, one of Escravos from Chevron and one of Qua Iboe from Mobil.
There was also unconfirmed talk that IOEc took a cargo of Suez Blend from Glencore.
